combat._npc_range: Aliens' firing range (if the type has no range field): private server code (Ow, Attackable.AttackRange: alien 450, player laser 700); DarkBot aliens turn back at 550-610 units (turning). combat._passive_follow: A non-aggressive alien follows the player: within distance, the wandering step is toward the player (± spread radians), never comes closer than nearby, does not fire. Official server recording (2026-10-25/27, steps within 1,500 units of aliens that did not fire at the player): Kristallon 81% approaching steps (direction cosine 0.68), Lordakium 0.70, Boss Lordakium 0.86, Cubikon 0.49, Blighted Kristallon 0.39, Plagued Kristallin 0.32, Purpose XXI 0.28; Streuner -0.02, Aider Streuner 0.16 and Saturn ships (negative) do not follow: exclude (type or prefix). combat._npc_notice_distance: adaptation: an aggressive NPC notices the player at this distance and chases (previously 500; does not notice in a safe zone)
combat._view_distance: Recording: the real server shows NPCs to the hero with ShipCreateCommand at ~1,800 units (23 events, 1,223-1,907, median ~1,730) and removes them with ShipRemoveCommand when they move away (15 events, 1,519-1,783); there is no noticeable delay margin, the drop is also 1,800 (hero position from MoveRequest ±150).
combat._radiation: darkorbit.fandom.com Radiation zone: outside the map boundary 1% of max HP per second, rising up to 5%. The rate of increase (+1% every 3 s) is an adaptation; it hits the hull, not the shield.

combat._x1_reward: darkorbitwiki.com aliens (Streuner, Recruit/Aider Streuner): from level 7, killing on your own X-1 map reduces the reward partially or completely, from 15 there is no reward at all (EP, honor, credits, uridium). Intermediate steps are an adaptation; no penalty on the enemy X-1. The contents of the bonus box (credits, uridium, ammo counts) also shrink by the same step (fandom 1-1, 2-1, Lowers: bonus boxes too; world.take_box).
combat._box_view: Recording: boxes and ores arrive via AddBoxCommand/AddOreCommand when ~1,000 units from the hero, and when moving away without being collected they are removed via RemoveCollectableCommand (161 times, 900-1,150 units). The drop distance is an adaptation.
combat._npc_range_fixed: firing range of stationary aliens (Mindfire Behemoth, Cubikon …): must be longer than the player's laser (700) and rocket (900) range, otherwise they are cut down without retaliating (wiki: Behemoth "longest range"; value is an adaptation)
combat._respawn_special: Boss/Uber, Cubikon (80), Battleray (115), Deadly Battleray (npc121), Invoke XVI (221) and Mindfire Behemoth (225) should not come back in 12-25 s like an ordinary alien. Key: by type or name "boss" (..::{), "uber".
